sections.title: SG13CMOS5L: nominal single-point and closed-loop results (failures retained)

gaps.title: No ratified spec table
gaps.text: The target spec is drafted in spec/target-spec.md (Status: DRAFT) but not ratified: it awaits the two-key ratification under ratification/. This summary therefore carries no pass/fail-versus-spec column and derives no target from any measurement.

gaps.title: Partial PVT axes
gaps.text: Most campaigns use a 3-bundle PVT convention (typ/slow/fast), a fixed supply (3.3 V) and a subset of band codes or trim codes; none is a full cross-product. Each dataset lists the corner coverage actually present in its CSVs. Targeted fine-trim and nominal records cover single tuples only.

gaps.text: The lock_detector bulk-on-VSS change (#136) was verified at the nominal corner only in the records citing this gap (RECORD-005 and its nominal rerun). A full-grid rerun of the bodyfix DUT exists (RECORD-011) with its own disclosed gaps (20x probe not run; ladder PDK-confounded); those records themselves are not re-verified across PVT.

gaps.title: Divider speed evidence
gaps.text: Maximum-input-frequency evidence for the repaired divider_chain is not part of this summary's selected sources (the edge counts exist in the SG13CMOS5L divider slug but are not selected); the SG13G2 divider has none.

gaps.title: cp up/dn mismatch yield graded against an unratified limit, undersized for the default CI
gaps.text: The 1500-sample campaign has now run (sg13cmos5l-cp-icp-trim-mc RECORD-002): pooled yield 63.47 % (95 % CI 60.97-65.91 %) against the bench's own +/-3.5 % screening limit, sigma 3.877 %. Two things keep this a gap. (a) No ratified cp mismatch limit exists, so no target_yield is declared and nothing is a pass/fail claim; the +/-3.5 % screening value is derived from closed-loop records measured on the pre-DR-010 cp. (b) klt yield's sample-size verdict is `insufficient`: N = 1500 resolves the yield to +/-2.47 pp, and 8907 samples are needed for the default +/-1 pp, so klt signoff grades T1 item 6 analog unmet / undersized_sample. Resizing the campaign is secondary to ratifying a limit, whose uncertainty dominates. vco duty cycle (row 13) and lock_detector threshold offset (row 16) still have no Monte Carlo evidence at all.

gaps.title: cp tracking dump buffer (DR-010) nominal-only
gaps.text: The VDUMP-tracks-VOUT buffer (DR-010) is evidenced at mos_tt/27 C/3.3 V only: the |VDUMP-VOUT| offset across PVT, the cp-icp-trim re-run across PVT, row 7 across PVT, Monte Carlo (random offset) and low Icp*Tref are owed (batch fleet: klayout-tools#2727, #2851, #2901). The cp layout was redrawn for DR-010 by #195 (LVS match, DRC/ERC clean, nominal klt pex re-run), but that nominal PEX bench measures only the output current and does not observe VDUMP tracking, so no post-layout tracking evidence exists.

gaps.title: Real-cp VOUT capacitance in the PM bench: typ only, DR-008 fast at risk
gaps.text: The DR-007/DR-008 row 6/6a tuples are re-checked with the real idle cp on VCTRL only at the typ bundle (mos_tt + res_typ, 27 C, 3.3 V), schematic-level. The fast/slow bundle grid is blocked on the batch fleet (klayout-tools#2851, #2727; job klt-sim-3a086f48e27a exited 87). DR-008 fast is projected to fall below 45 deg PM (about 44.77-44.93 deg) once the cp is included; that projection applies a typ-model sensitivity to the fast baseline, is an estimate and not a verdict, and the measured answer is tracked in #203. Layout parasitics of the cp (#195) are not included.
